generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers all OFAC-covered products, screening configuration and closed-alert samples
generic.In-scope period: The most recently completed periodic OFAC programme review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Review memo records scope, configuration checks, sample results and findings
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sampled closed-alert count matches the count logged in the disposition tracker
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed review memo filed in the compliance evidence repository with review date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Configuration or SLA gaps logged in the GRC platform with a remediation owner
generic.Test population: Risk-based sample of closed alerts from the review period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Review passes if configuration, cadence and SLAs match current policy with no unlogged gaps
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps escalate to the Financial Crime AML Officer for remediation tracking in the GRC platform
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when scope, configuration checks, sample testing and findings are all recorded
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform programme review record and compliance evidence repository

steps.title: Open the OFAC programme record and confirm the current covered-product scope
sop: Open the sanctions programme record in the GRC platform.
Pull the current covered-product and business-line list configured for the programme.
Compare it against the last approved scope statement on file.
Done when the current covered-product scope is confirmed against the prior approved statement.
verify: Check the confirmed scope against the GRC platform's live programme configuration.
Pass when the confirmed scope matches the live configuration with no unexplained gaps.

steps.title: Confirm screening engine configuration, list cadence and escalation SLAs
sop: Open the screening engine configuration record referenced in the GRC platform.
Record the current list-update cadence and escalation SLA settings.
Compare recorded settings to the policy-mandated cadence and SLA table.
Done when configuration, cadence and SLA settings are confirmed current against policy.
verify: Re-check the recorded settings against the live screening engine configuration.
Pass when recorded settings match the policy-mandated cadence and SLA exactly.

steps.title: Verify the AML compliance officer designation and reporting line
sop: Open the current AML officer designation record in the GRC platform.
Confirm the named officer and reporting line match the latest Board-approved designation.
Flag any mismatch for correction before the review memo is finalized.
Done when the designation and reporting line are confirmed accurate.
verify: Compare the confirmed designation to the Board-approved designation letter.
Pass when the designation and reporting line match with no open discrepancy.

steps.title: Sample closed alerts from the review period for disposition consistency
sop: Pull a risk-based sample of closed alerts from the review-period disposition tracker.
Re-examine each sampled alert's disposition rationale for consistency with policy.
Note any inconsistent or under-documented disposition in the sample working file.
Done when the sample is reviewed and any inconsistencies are noted.
verify: Cross-check flagged inconsistencies against the disposition tracker record.
Pass when every sampled alert's disposition is consistent or the exception is logged.

steps.title: Record review findings and control gaps in the programme review memo
sop: Draft the programme review memo summarizing configuration, designation and sample-testing results.
Document any control gap identified with a proposed remediation owner and target date.
Route the draft memo to the Compliance Analyst for a completeness check.
Done when the review memo with findings and gaps is drafted and routed for check.
verify: Confirm the memo covers scope, configuration, designation and sample results.
Pass when the memo is complete and any gaps carry an owner and target date.

steps.title: Sign off the review memo and file it in the compliance evidence repository
sop: Review the completed memo for accuracy and sign it as the reviewing officer.
Upload the signed memo to the compliance evidence repository with the review date.
Log the review completion and any open findings in the GRC platform programme record.
Done when the signed memo is filed and the GRC platform record is updated.
verify: Retrieve the filed memo from the compliance evidence repository to confirm the signature and date.
Pass when the signed memo is retrievable and the GRC platform record reflects completion.

generic.Defined scope/population: Engagement scope covers screening, list management and alert adjudication for the review period
generic.In-scope period: Current independent review cycle scheduled with Internal Audit or the external reviewer
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Engagement record captures scope, kickoff date, evidence requests and findings
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Evidence-request count in AuditBoard matches items actually provided to the reviewer
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Engagement scoping document and evidence log filed with dated version history
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Overdue evidence requests logged in AuditBoard with an assigned owner
generic.Test population: Sample of closed alerts and configuration exports provided to the reviewer
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Engagement passes when scope is agreed, fielded on schedule and all evidence requests are closed
generic.Exception handling path: Open evidence requests escalate to the Compliance Manager for closure
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when scoping, fieldwork, evidence tracking and findings are all logged
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard engagement workspace and compliance evidence repository

steps.title: Confirm the engagement scope with Internal Audit or the external reviewer
sop: Meet with Internal Audit or the external compliance reviewer to agree engagement scope.
Confirm the scope covers screening, list management and alert adjudication.
Record the agreed scope statement in the AuditBoard engagement record.
Done when the agreed scope is recorded in the AuditBoard engagement record.
verify: Compare the recorded scope statement against the reviewer's engagement letter.
Pass when the recorded scope matches the engagement letter exactly.

steps.title: Provide screening engine configuration exports and a closed-alert sample
sop: Export the current screening engine configuration for the in-scope period.
Pull a representative sample of closed alerts from the case management archive.
Upload both packages to the AuditBoard engagement workspace for reviewer access.
Done when configuration exports and the alert sample are uploaded to AuditBoard.
verify: Confirm the reviewer can access both uploaded packages in AuditBoard.
Pass when both packages are present and accessible to the reviewer.

steps.title: Schedule the review kickoff and fieldwork dates in AuditBoard
sop: Open the AuditBoard engagement calendar for the sanctions programme review.
Enter agreed kickoff and fieldwork dates confirmed with the reviewer.
Notify Financial Crime AML Officer of the scheduled dates for evidence readiness.
Done when kickoff and fieldwork dates are entered and the notification is sent.
verify: Check the AuditBoard calendar entry against the reviewer-confirmed dates.
Pass when calendar dates match the reviewer's confirmation email.

steps.title: Track open evidence requests to closure in the engagement workspace
sop: Review the list of open evidence requests in the AuditBoard engagement workspace.
Respond to each request with the requested document or data extract.
Mark each fulfilled request as closed with the date provided.
Done when every open evidence request is answered or marked closed.
verify: Confirm no evidence request remains open past its due date in AuditBoard.
Pass when all evidence requests are closed with an attached response.

steps.title: Log the review completion date and headline findings
sop: Obtain the reviewer's completion notice and headline findings summary.
Enter the completion date and findings summary into the sanctions programme governance file.
Cross-reference any finding to the AuditBoard engagement record.
Done when the completion date and findings are logged in the governance file.
verify: Compare the logged findings against the reviewer's final report.
Pass when logged findings match the final report with no omission.

steps.title: File the engagement record and evidence log in the compliance evidence repository
sop: Compile the final engagement scope, evidence log and findings summary.
Upload the compiled package to the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the retention flag matching the sanctions recordkeeping requirement.
Done when the compiled package is filed with the correct retention flag.
verify: Retrieve the filed package from the compliance evidence repository.
Pass when the package is retrievable and correctly retention-flagged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policy scope covers all covered products and lists subject to risk-based sanctions screening
generic.In-scope period: Current annual policy review and approval cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy document states scope, screening cadence, escalation matrix and effective date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Published policy version count in SharePoint matches the GRC approval record
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved policy and approval record filed with version number and effective date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unresolved cross-reference gap logged in the GRC platform with an owner
generic.Test population: Current draft policy and its cross-references to the AML programme and SOPs
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Policy passes when approved, published and all cross-references are current
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved cross-reference or approval delay escalates to the Financial Crime AML Officer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the policy is approved, published and filed with evidence
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint policy library and compliance evidence repository

steps.title: Update the sanctions screening policy for current risk-based scoping
sop: Open the current sanctions screening policy document in SharePoint.
Revise the covered-product and list scope sections to reflect current risk-based scoping.
Update any changed screening cadence or escalation threshold language.
Done when the policy draft reflects current risk-based scope and cadence.
verify: Compare the revised scope section against the current covered-product list in the GRC platform.
Pass when the policy scope matches the GRC platform's covered-product list.

steps.title: Route the draft policy through the annual approval workflow
sop: Submit the draft policy into the GRC platform annual approval workflow.
Assign the required reviewers and approvers per the workflow configuration.
Track the workflow status until all approvals are recorded.
Done when all required approvals are recorded in the GRC platform workflow.
verify: Check the GRC platform workflow record for complete approval sign-off.
Pass when every required approver has signed off in the workflow.

steps.title: Publish the approved policy and retire the prior version
sop: Upload the approved policy to the SharePoint policy library as the current version.
Mark the prior version as retired with a superseded-by reference to the new version.
Confirm the effective date is set to the approval date.
Done when the new version is published and the prior version is marked retired.
verify: Open the SharePoint policy library to confirm only the new version is marked current.
Pass when the library shows the new version as current and the prior as retired.

steps.title: Confirm cross-references to the AML programme and escalation matrix are current
sop: Check each cross-reference in the policy to the AML programme document and escalation matrix.
Update any cross-reference that points to a superseded document version.
Log any unresolved cross-reference gap in the GRC platform for follow-up.
Done when all cross-references are checked and any gaps are logged.
verify: Open each cross-referenced document to confirm the version link is current.
Pass when all cross-references resolve to current-version documents.

steps.title: File the approved policy and approval record in the compliance evidence repository
sop: Compile the approved policy, approval workflow record and effective date.
Upload the compiled package to the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the retention flag per the recordkeeping schedule.
Done when the package is filed with the correct retention flag applied.
verify: Retrieve the filed package from the compliance evidence repository.
Pass when the package is retrievable with the approval record intact.

steps.title: Confirm the published policy is accessible to all required readers
sop: Open the SharePoint policy library from a standard staff account.
Confirm the published policy opens without an access error.
Check that the policy appears in the required-reading list for in-scope roles.
Done when the published policy is confirmed accessible and listed for required reading.
verify: Attempt to open the policy from a non-owner account.
Pass when the policy opens without an access error and appears in required reading.

generic.Defined scope/population: OFAC SDN/Consolidated, UN Consolidated and EU consolidated lists loaded into the screening engine
generic.In-scope period: Current watchlist update cycle triggered by the latest published list version
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Watchlist change log records list version, checksum, load timestamp and analyst sign-off
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-load active-entry count reconciles to the prior version plus net additions/removals
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Watchlist change log entry retained with load timestamp and list version number
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any reconciliation break or import error logged with a remediation note
generic.Test population: New or amended entries and their fuzzy-matching aliases/AKAs for the update
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Update passes when checksum matches source, reconciliation ties out and aliases import correctly
generic.Exception handling path: Checksum mismatch or reconciliation break escalates to the Financial Crime AML Officer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when lists are loaded, reconciled, alias-checked and logged with sign-off
generic.Evidence location: NICE Actimize watchlist change log and GRC platform programme record

steps.title: Load the current OFAC, UN and EU consolidated lists into the Actimize watchlist module
sop: Open the NICE Actimize watchlist administration module.
Import the latest published OFAC SDN and Consolidated, UN Consolidated and EU consolidated list files.
Stage the imported lists in the pending-activation queue.
Done when all three lists are staged in the pending-activation queue.
verify: Check the staged list version numbers against the source publication pages.
Pass when staged versions match the source publication versions exactly.

steps.title: Confirm list checksum/version against the publishing source before activating
sop: Compare the checksum of each staged list file against the publisher's posted checksum.
Confirm the version identifier matches the source publication date.
Hold activation if any checksum mismatch is found.
Done when checksum and version are confirmed to match the publishing source.
verify: Re-run the checksum comparison a second time before activation.
Pass when the checksum matches on both comparison runs.

steps.title: Activate the update and run a post-load reconciliation count
sop: Activate the staged lists in the Actimize watchlist module.
Run the post-load active-entry count report for each list.
Compare the new count to the prior version plus logged additions and removals.
Done when the post-load count reconciles to the prior version plus net changes.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation manually against the publisher's change summary.
Pass when the reconciled count matches the publisher's stated change summary.

steps.title: Verify fuzzy-matching aliases and AKAs imported correctly
sop: Select a sample of new or amended entries from the activated list.
Open each entry in Actimize to confirm aliases and AKAs are attached.
Run a test search on a known alias to confirm it surfaces the correct entry.
Done when the sampled aliases and AKAs are confirmed correctly attached.
verify: Compare the attached aliases against the source list file's alias field.
Pass when sampled aliases match the source file with no missing AKA.

steps.title: Log the watchlist update event with timestamp and sign-off
sop: Open the watchlist change log in the GRC platform.
Enter the load timestamp, list versions and reconciliation result for the update.
Sign off the change log entry as the reviewing officer.
Done when the change log entry is signed off with timestamp and versions recorded.
verify: Retrieve the signed change log entry to confirm all fields are populated.
Pass when the entry is complete and carries the officer sign-off.

steps.title: Confirm the live screening engine reflects the activated lists
sop: Open the live Actimize watchlist configuration screen.
Confirm the OFAC, UN and EU lists show the newly activated version numbers.
Run a quick test search against a known new entry to confirm it is live.
Done when the live configuration is confirmed to reflect the activated lists.
verify: Recheck the live version numbers against the change log entry.
Pass when the live version numbers match the logged change entry exactly.

generic.Defined scope/population: All watchlist update entries processed in the NICE Actimize administration module for the period
generic.In-scope period: Audit trail export period matching the current retention/reporting cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Audit log entry shows source publication timestamp and system load timestamp per update
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exported audit log entry count matches the number of list updates processed in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audit trail export filed with the review-period tag and retention flag applied
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Updates exceeding the mandated processing window flagged for remediation
generic.Test population: Every watchlist update entry logged in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Passes when every update was processed within the mandated timeframe
generic.Exception handling path: Late-processed update escalates to the Sanctions Analyst lead for remediation
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the export is archived, tagged and retention-flagged
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository audit trail archive

steps.title: Export the watchlist update audit log from the Actimize administration module
sop: Open the NICE Actimize administration module audit log for the review period.
Set the export date range to match the current reporting cycle.
Generate and download the audit log export file.
Done when the audit log export file is downloaded for the review period.
verify: Open the export file and confirm the date range matches the requested period.
Pass when the export covers the full requested review period.

steps.title: Confirm each update entry shows load timestamp against source publication timestamp
sop: Review each log entry's load timestamp field in the export.
Compare it to the corresponding source publication timestamp.
Calculate the processing gap for each entry.
Done when the processing gap is calculated for every entry in the export.
verify: Spot-check a sample of calculated gaps against the raw timestamps.
Pass when spot-checked gaps match the raw timestamp calculation.

steps.title: Flag updates that exceeded the mandated processing window
sop: Identify entries where the processing gap exceeds the mandated timeframe.
Mark each exceeding entry for remediation in the audit trail working file.
Note the cause of delay where known.
Done when all exceeding entries are flagged with a noted cause.
verify: Recount flagged entries against the calculated-gap list.
Pass when every entry exceeding the window is flagged with no omission.

steps.title: Archive the audit trail export to the compliance evidence repository
sop: Upload the finalized audit trail export to the compliance evidence repository.
Tag the upload with the review period identifier.
Confirm the flagged exceptions are attached or cross-referenced.
Done when the export is archived with the review period tag applied.
verify: Retrieve the archived export from the repository to confirm the tag and content.
Pass when the archived export is retrievable with the correct tag.

steps.title: Confirm the ten-year sanctions retention flag is applied
sop: Open the archived export's metadata in the compliance evidence repository.
Apply or confirm the ten-year sanctions recordkeeping retention flag.
Save the metadata update.
Done when the ten-year retention flag is confirmed applied.
verify: Check the document metadata for the retention flag value.
Pass when the retention flag shows the ten-year sanctions recordkeeping setting.

steps.title: Confirm the archived audit trail is retrievable for the review period
sop: Open the compliance evidence repository and search by the review-period tag.
Confirm the archived audit trail export returns in the search results.
Open the file to confirm it matches the exported content.
Done when the archived audit trail is confirmed retrievable by review-period tag.
verify: Perform a second search using only the review-period tag.
Pass when the search returns the correct archived audit trail file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Annual OFAC/sanctions programme assessment covering risk rating, coverage and open items
generic.In-scope period: Current annual assessment cycle pending leadership review
generic.Required fields populated and valid: GRC record captures circulation date, presented findings and sign-off
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open-item count presented matches the count in the GRC platform tracker
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed assessment and sign-off evidence filed with the review date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Board or leadership commentary logged with a follow-up owner
generic.Test population: Full annual assessment document circulated for review
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Passes when Head of Compliance sign-off is recorded before the filing deadline
generic.Exception handling path: Missing sign-off escalates to the Financial Crime AML Officer for follow-up
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when circulation, presentation, sign-off and filing are all recorded
generic.Evidence location: Board portal record and compliance evidence repository

steps.title: Circulate the annual assessment to senior management and the Board via the board portal
sop: Upload the finalized annual OFAC/sanctions assessment to the board portal.
Add senior management and Board recipients to the circulation list.
Send the circulation notice ahead of the scheduled review date.
Done when the assessment is circulated to all required recipients in the board portal.
verify: Check the board portal circulation log for recipient confirmation.
Pass when all required recipients show as notified in the portal.

steps.title: Present risk assessment findings, coverage and open items for review
sop: Prepare the presentation summarizing risk ratings, screening coverage and open items.
Present the findings at the scheduled leadership review session.
Note any question or requested clarification raised during the session.
Done when the findings are presented and questions are noted.
verify: Compare presented figures against the underlying GRC platform assessment record.
Pass when presented figures match the GRC platform record exactly.

steps.title: Capture the Head of Compliance sign-off in the GRC platform record
sop: Review the presented assessment and supporting findings.
Record sign-off decision in the GRC platform assessment record.
Note any conditions attached to the sign-off.
Done when sign-off is recorded in the GRC platform assessment record.
verify: Open the GRC platform record to confirm the sign-off entry is present.
Pass when the sign-off entry is recorded with the Head of Compliance's name and date.

steps.title: Log Board or senior-management commentary and follow-up actions
sop: Capture any commentary or follow-up request raised by the Board or senior management.
Enter each item into the GRC platform with an assigned owner and target date.
Confirm the assessment record reflects the follow-up items.
Done when all commentary and follow-up actions are logged with an owner.
verify: Review the logged items against the meeting notes or minutes.
Pass when every raised item is logged with an owner and target date.

steps.title: File the signed assessment and sign-off evidence
sop: Compile the signed assessment, sign-off record and follow-up log.
Upload the compiled package to the compliance evidence repository.
Confirm the retention flag is applied per policy.
Done when the package is filed with the retention flag applied.
verify: Retrieve the filed package from the compliance evidence repository.
Pass when the package is retrievable with the sign-off evidence intact.

steps.title: Confirm the GRC platform programme record reflects the leadership review
sop: Open the GRC platform sanctions programme record.
Confirm the record shows the leadership review as complete with the sign-off date.
Confirm any logged follow-up action is visible on the programme record.
Done when the programme record reflects the completed leadership review.
verify: Reopen the programme record to confirm the review status field.
Pass when the record shows the review complete with the correct sign-off date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Lists configured in the Actimize watchlist module versus the applicable OFAC/UN/EU/HMT set
generic.In-scope period: Current annual coverage review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: AuditBoard record captures the comparison, sample test results and gaps found
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Configured list count matches the count of applicable regulatory list sources
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed coverage review and findings filed with the review date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage gaps logged in Archer GRC with remediation owners
generic.Test population: Sample of known SDN entries tested for match surfacing in the screening engine
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Passes when every applicable list is configured and sample entries surface a match
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or misconfigured list source escalates to the Financial Crime AML Officer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when comparison, sample testing and gap logging are all recorded
generic.Evidence location: Archer GRC coverage gap register and AuditBoard review record

steps.title: Compare configured lists in Actimize against the applicable OFAC/UN/EU/HMT set
sop: Open the NICE Actimize watchlist module list configuration screen.
Pull the current applicable regulatory list set (OFAC, UN, EU, HMT) for comparison.
Compare the configured lists against the applicable set line by line.
Done when the configured lists are compared against the applicable regulatory set.
verify: Recheck the comparison against the regulator's published list index.
Pass when the comparison matches the published list index with no omission.

steps.title: Identify any stale, missing, or misconfigured list source
sop: Review each configured list's last-updated timestamp for staleness.
Note any applicable list source missing from the configuration.
Record any misconfiguration found (wrong version, incomplete import).
Done when stale, missing or misconfigured sources are identified and noted.
verify: Cross-check noted issues against the Actimize configuration audit log.
Pass when every identified issue is confirmed in the configuration audit log.

steps.title: Test a sample of known SDN entries for match surfacing
sop: Select a sample of known SDN entries from the current OFAC list.
Run each sample entry through the Actimize screening engine test function.
Confirm each sample entry surfaces a match at the expected score.
Done when the sample entries are confirmed to surface a match.
verify: Review the match results against expected scores for each sample entry.
Pass when every sample entry surfaces a match at or above the expected score.

steps.title: Log identified coverage gaps and control weaknesses in Archer GRC
sop: Open the coverage gap register in Archer GRC.
Enter each identified gap or weakness with a description and severity.
Assign a remediation owner and target date to each entry.
Done when all gaps are logged in Archer GRC with an owner and target date.
verify: Review the Archer GRC register for completeness against the identified gap list.
Pass when every identified gap has a logged owner and target date.

steps.title: Record the completed coverage review in AuditBoard
sop: Compile the completed review summary, sample results and logged gaps.
Upload the summary to the AuditBoard review record.
Confirm the record status is set to complete.
Done when the review record in AuditBoard is marked complete.
verify: Open the AuditBoard record to confirm status and attached summary.
Pass when the record status shows complete with the summary attached.

steps.title: Confirm the coverage review is cross-referenced in Archer GRC
sop: Open the Archer GRC coverage gap register.
Confirm each logged gap links back to the AuditBoard review record.
Confirm no gap is listed without a linked review reference.
Done when every logged gap is cross-referenced to the AuditBoard review record.
verify: Click through a sample of gap entries to confirm the AuditBoard link resolves.
Pass when the sampled links resolve to the correct AuditBoard review record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Screening volume, alert-disposition and list-update metrics for the annual reporting period
generic.In-scope period: Current annual Financial Crime Committee reporting cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report includes volume, disposition mix, staffing and open remediation items
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported alert volume reconciles to the screening engine's monthly totals
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submitted report and delivery confirmation filed with submission date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any metric discrepancy corrected before submission and noted in the report
generic.Test population: Full period's screening and alert-disposition metric set
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Passes when the report is reviewed, reconciled and delivered on schedule
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciliation break routes back to the AML Analyst for correction before submission
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the report is compiled, reviewed, submitted and filed
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform submission record and compliance evidence repository

steps.title: Compile screening volume and disposition metrics in Power BI
sop: Open the Power BI sanctions metrics workbook for the reporting period.
Refresh screening volume, alert-disposition and list-update figures.
Confirm the figures cover the full reporting period.
Done when the metrics workbook is refreshed with the full period's figures.
verify: Spot-check refreshed figures against the underlying source export.
Pass when spot-checked figures match the source export exactly.

steps.title: Draft the annual programme status narrative
sop: Draft the narrative covering coverage, staffing and open remediation items.
Reference the Power BI metrics to support each narrative point.
Save the draft for manager review.
Done when the narrative draft referencing the metrics is complete.
verify: Check each narrative claim against its supporting metric in Power BI.
Pass when every narrative claim is supported by the underlying metric.

steps.title: Route the draft report through Compliance Manager review
sop: Review the draft report for accuracy and completeness.
Note any correction required before submission.
Return the reviewed draft with comments or approval.
Done when the draft is reviewed with comments or approval recorded.
verify: Confirm all review comments are addressed in the revised draft.
Pass when the Compliance Manager approves the revised draft.

steps.title: Submit the finalized report to the Financial Crime Committee secretariat
sop: Finalize the report incorporating the Compliance Manager's review comments.
Submit the finalized report through the GRC platform to the committee secretariat.
Confirm the submission is logged with a timestamp.
Done when the report is submitted and logged in the GRC platform.
verify: Check the GRC platform submission log for the report entry.
Pass when the submission entry shows the correct report version and timestamp.

steps.title: File the submitted report and delivery confirmation
sop: Retrieve the delivery confirmation from the GRC platform submission log.
Upload the report and confirmation to the compliance evidence repository.
Apply the appropriate retention flag.
Done when the report and confirmation are filed with the retention flag applied.
verify: Retrieve the filed package from the compliance evidence repository.
Pass when the package is retrievable with the delivery confirmation attached.

steps.title: Confirm the Financial Crime Committee secretariat logged receipt
sop: Check the GRC platform submission workflow for a secretariat receipt confirmation.
Follow up with the secretariat if no receipt confirmation appears.
Log the confirmed receipt date once received.
Done when the secretariat's receipt of the report is confirmed and logged.
verify: Reopen the GRC platform to confirm the receipt log entry.
Pass when the log shows a confirmed secretariat receipt date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open sanctions programme audit findings in the AuditBoard issue tracker
generic.In-scope period: Findings open as of the current reporting cycle through their due date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each finding record shows owner, due date, closure evidence and validation status
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open-finding count in AuditBoard matches the register used for committee reporting
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure evidence attached to each finding with the validation date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Findings past due date escalated with an updated remediation plan
generic.Test population: Every open finding due for closure in the reporting cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Passes when every finding is closed with validated evidence or has an active remediation plan
generic.Exception handling path: Past-due findings escalate to the Financial Crime AML Officer
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when the register reflects current status for every finding
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard issue tracker and GRC platform findings register

steps.title: Load open audit findings into the AuditBoard issue tracker
sop: Pull the current list of open sanctions programme audit findings.
Enter each finding into the AuditBoard issue tracker with owner and due date.
Confirm no open finding is missing from the tracker.
Done when all open findings are entered with owner and due date.
verify: Compare the tracker entries against the original audit report finding list.
Pass when every original finding appears in the tracker.

steps.title: Request closure evidence from the finding owner ahead of the target date
sop: Identify findings approaching their target closure date.
Send a closure-evidence request to each finding owner.
Log the request date in the AuditBoard tracker.
Done when closure-evidence requests are sent and logged for approaching findings.
verify: Check the AuditBoard tracker for the logged request date on each finding.
Pass when every approaching finding shows a logged request date.

steps.title: Validate closure evidence against the original finding
sop: Review the closure evidence submitted for each finding.
Compare the evidence against the original finding's root cause and remediation requirement.
Update the finding status to closed if the evidence is sufficient.
Done when evidence is validated and the status is updated accordingly.
verify: Re-examine a sample of closed findings against their attached evidence.
Pass when sampled closures are supported by sufficient validated evidence.

steps.title: Escalate findings past their due date
sop: Identify findings that have passed their due date without validated closure.
Escalate each overdue finding to the Financial Crime AML Officer.
Log the escalation date and reason in the AuditBoard tracker.
Done when overdue findings are escalated and logged.
verify: Check the AuditBoard tracker for the escalation entry on each overdue finding.
Pass when every overdue finding shows a logged escalation.

steps.title: Update the audit findings register for the next committee report
sop: Refresh the GRC platform findings register with current AuditBoard statuses.
Confirm counts of open, closed and escalated findings reconcile between systems.

generic.Defined scope/population: Name-matching fuzzy-logic thresholds and parameters configured in the screening engine

steps.title: Analyze alert volume and false-positive rate by match-score band

Identify bands driving the highest false-positive rate.

verify: Cross-check the identified bands against the Power BI screening analytics dashboard.
Pass when the identified bands match the Power BI analysis.

steps.title: Propose revised fuzzy-matching thresholds and name-variant sensitivity
sop: Draft the revised threshold and name-variant sensitivity settings in the tuning workbench.
Document the rationale for each proposed change.
Save the proposal for back-testing.
Done when the revised threshold proposal is drafted with rationale.
verify: Review the proposal against the identified false-positive drivers.
Pass when the proposal directly addresses the identified drivers.

steps.title: Run the proposed thresholds against a historical alert sample
sop: Load the historical alert sample into the tuning workbench.
Run the sample against both current and proposed thresholds.
Compare detection of known true matches between the two threshold sets.
Done when the comparison confirms detection is not degraded.
verify: Re-run the comparison a second time to confirm consistent results.
Pass when both runs confirm no true match is missed under the proposed thresholds.

steps.title: Obtain sign-off on the threshold change before deployment
sop: Review the back-test results and proposed threshold change.
Confirm the change does not degrade true-match detection.

verify: Open the change log to confirm the sign-off entry is present.

Confirm the live configuration reflects the deployed thresholds.

verify: Check the live Actimize configuration against the logged deployed thresholds.
Pass when the live configuration matches the logged deployment exactly.

steps.title: Confirm alert volume after the first cycle matches the tuning objective

Done when the post-deployment impact is confirmed and logged.
verify: Recompute the volume comparison independently from the case queue.
Pass when the recomputed volume matches the logged confirmed impact.

generic.Defined scope/population: Typology finding requiring translation into a new screening detection rule
generic.In-scope period: Current rule-development cycle following the typology finding

steps.title: Translate the typology finding into a proposed detection rule

Save the draft rule for back-testing.
Done when the proposed detection rule logic is drafted and saved.
verify: Reread the draft rule against the typology finding's indicators.
Pass when the draft rule directly addresses the typology's indicators.

steps.title: Back-test the proposed rule against historical transaction data
sop: Load historical transaction data into the Actimize test environment.
Run the proposed rule against the historical data.
Estimate the resulting alert-volume impact.
Done when the back-test estimates the alert-volume impact for the proposed rule.
verify: Re-run the back-test to confirm consistent volume estimates.
Pass when repeated runs produce consistent volume estimates.

steps.title: Document the rule rationale linking to the source typology finding
sop: Draft the rule rationale explaining the link to the source typology finding.
Attach the back-test results supporting the rationale.
Save the documented rationale to the rule record.
Done when the rule rationale is documented and linked to the typology finding.
verify: Reopen the rule record to confirm the rationale references the typology finding.
Pass when the rationale explicitly references the source finding.

steps.title: Obtain Sanctions Analyst sign-off on the rule logic
sop: Review the proposed rule logic and back-test results.
Confirm the rule logic is sound and the volume impact is acceptable.
Record sign-off on the rule record.
Done when sign-off is recorded on the rule record.
verify: Reopen the rule record to confirm the sign-off entry is present.
Pass when the sign-off entry carries the Sanctions Analyst's name and date.

Log the effective date and expected alert volume in the change record.
Confirm the live configuration reflects the deployed rule.

verify: Check the live configuration against the logged deployed rule.
Pass when the live configuration matches the logged deployment exactly.
